quote: Question-answer pair generation (QAG) is to do question generation (QG) and answer generation (AG) simultaneously only with a given passage.

In this paper, we propose a new architecture to deal with this real‑world QAG task... It consists of three parts: rough keyphrase generation agent, question‑keyphrase iterative generation module and answer generation agent. ... We aim to generate multiple Q‑A pairs with a given document as the only input.
We are the first to perform QAG task on RACE. The proposed methods can be easily applied to real-world examination to produce reading comprehension data.
